svg.title: Cycle Time
svg.desc: Cycle Time Sequence Verification & Process Timing Calculates the total execution time for the welding process, whether performed by a human operator or an automated robot, based on actual trajectory length and assigned travel speeds. Parameter Validation: Strictly verifies that every weld line has proper Heat Source and Process parameters assigned before allowing the export. Drag & Drop Sequencer: Includes an interactive table interface to visually reorder and organize the welding sequence prior to generating the report. Detailed Analytics: Exports a hierarchical Excel report breaking down the time spent per subassembly, position, and robotic cell.
